title: 많다, 싫다: 겹받침 ㄶ ㅀ 소리 내기
objective: You can read words with ㄶ and ㅀ aloud, knowing when ㅎ strengthens the next sound and when it goes silent.
summary: Learn how ㄶ and ㅀ sound in words like 많다 and 싫다.

task.title: Read and write sounds
task.line: Say each word out loud, then write how it really sounds or finish the sentence.

words.meaning: to be many, a lot (there are a lot of)
words.exampleMeaning: There are a lot of people on the subway.

words.meaning: not (used as -지 않다 after a verb or adjective)
to not like, to not want
to dislike (action verb, takes 을/를; can be used for yourself or others)
words.exampleMeaning: My younger sibling doesn't like milk.

letters.as: Say ㄴ; ㅎ turns the next ㄱ/ㄷ/ㅈ into ㅋ/ㅌ/ㅊ.
Say ㄹ; ㅎ turns the next ㄱ/ㄷ/ㅈ into ㅋ/ㅌ/ㅊ.
Before a vowel, ㅎ is silent; ㄴ moves to the next syllable.

exercises: Write the real sound in [ ]: ① 많고 ② 싫지 ③ 않게
Write the real sound in [ ]. Remember, ㅎ is silent before a vowel: ① 많아서 ② 싫으면 ③ 않아요
Fill in the blank with 많아요 or 싫어요, then write its sound: ① 집에 사과가 ____. ② 저는 더운 여름이 ____.
Answer in Korean with 아니요 and the word in ( ), then write the sound of the last word: ① 커피 좋아해요? (싫어하다) ② 학교가 멀어요? (-지 않다)
answers: ① 아니요, 커피를 싫어해요. [시러해요] (아니요, 싫어해요.) ② 아니요, 멀지 않아요. [아나요]
